heroHeadline: Pentagon Adds Retroactive US Casualty to Iran War Toll Amid Transparency Concerns
heroSubtitle: Day 227 (October 12, 2026): Pentagon belatedly adds a US service member death to the official Iran war toll six months after the fact, raising accountability concerns about casualty reporting transparency during the conflict.
